name: arsenal
description: Mirko Bozzetto's curated skills for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ...)

plugins.name: websearch
plugins.description: Power search via Exa MCP. 8 modes: quick, deep, code, docs, debug, news, compare, research.

plugins.name: code-roadmap
plugins.description: Orientation map at task start: matches intent to available skills, prints a recommended chain + execution mode + reflection level. Advisory only.

plugins.name: arsenal
plugins.description: Portable Socratic roadmap workflow with native Claude Code, OMP, and Codex agents, a complete solo fallback, and self-contained offline HTML rendering.

plugins.name: brief
plugins.description: Author a product brief by interview (the PRD tradition, under a plainer name), then emit user stories, scope, metrics, and a derived nested task list.

plugins.name: propose
plugins.description: Design workflow in the RFC tradition: problem -> alternatives -> tradeoffs -> design -> risks -> recommendation -> impl plan. Two sizes with hard ceilings.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Spec executor. Implements a finalized prd or Accepted rfc (or a bare prompt via inline contract) on agent-teams/subagents/solo, emits a user-run verification bundle + trace ledger.

plugins.name: next
plugins.description: Query unfinished prd/rfc/ship work and the exact command to resume it. Derives an open-work board from artifact frontmatter; a SessionStart hook auto-surfaces it so context survives /clear.

plugins.name: issue
plugins.description: Use GitHub issues as cross-session resolution memory. Create/update/resume self-contained, cold-readable issues via gh CLI.

plugins.name: trace
plugins.description: Project progress ledger written automatically. A Stop hook logs the working-tree delta each turn that touched files (ship, rfc, or plain conversation), so what moved is recorded without remembering to log; next reads it.
